approved_generation.rule: A filename from a superseded generation is not a missing variant to reconstruct. If a needed variant appears absent, mark it 待确认 and ask the brand owner; never rebuild it from an older name or an older file.

policy.svg: source of truth for geometry and color, AND the editable vector master — open it directly in Illustrator, Figma or Inkscape
policy.png: bundled raster delivery; use directly for web/social/office export
policy.png_hires: large icon exports for app icon, avatar, favicon, large-format
policy.jpg: preview only; not bundled; fetch from the source folder when needed

vector_source.immutable: Editable describes how the master is used — opened, measured, placed and exported from — not a licence to alter the mark. Every bundled asset is pinned by SHA-256 in assets/logo-checksums.json and validated in CI. A changed mark is a new official delivery, never a local edit.
vector_source.no_ai_required: The delivery ships no .ai file, and none is required: the SVG is the editable vector source. Do not treat the absence of .ai as a gap, and do not go hunting for .ai drafts in order to edit the mark.
vector_source.verified: All 25 SVGs are pure vector — <path> geometry, real <linearGradient> defs, no embedded raster <image>, no external references, and a viewBox. Verified 2026-09-25.
vector_source.outlined_text: The wordmark is outlined: the SVGs contain no live <text> element, which is standard for a logo and keeps rendering identical everywhere.

source_layout.comment: The delivery's own folder layout differs from the bundled layout; this explains why earlier records said 24 PNG files.
source_layout.delivery_svg_dir: 34 files = 25 SVG sources + the 9 high-resolution/512 transparent PNG exports
source_layout.bundling_rule: SVG sources -> assets/logos/svg/; the delivery's png/ -> assets/logos/png/; the delivery's svg/*.png -> assets/logos/png-hires/.
source_layout.one_extra_png: assets/logos/png/蓝色纯色_无文字_方圆通用_图形标.png has no counterpart in the delivery's png/ folder. It is byte-identical to the delivery's svg/蓝色纯色_无文字_方圆通用_图形标.png (a 512px transparent export, the same file as the png-hires entry). It was copied into png/ so that every SVG has a same-size raster beside it, keeping the pair check green. The delivery's png/ really does hold 24, so both '24' and '25' were defensible for differently-scoped records; the bundled inventory is 25.

verified.method: rsvg-convert render of each SVG compared against bundled PNG at native size

reverified.method: SHA-256 byte-for-byte comparison of every bundled asset against the delivery folder, plus scripts/render_logo.sh --verify-all
reverified.result: 25/25 SVG identical, 24/24 delivery PNG identical, 9/9 png-hires identical; all 25 SVG re-renders match the bundled PNG bit-for-bit
reverified.note: The bundle is current; no asset needed re-syncing.

rendering.required: rsvg-convert (librsvg) or another spec-complete SVG renderer
rendering.known_bad: ImageMagick's internal MSVG/XML renderer mangles the gradient stops in these files; it renders them darker and flattens parts of the mark. Do not use `magick file.svg` for logo output.
rendering.safe_fallback: Use the bundled PNG directly instead of converting the SVG yourself.
rendering.after_render: Verify against the bundled PNG with `magick compare -metric RMSE` before placing the logo.

naming.color: 白色渐变 / 白色纯色 / 蓝色渐变 / 蓝色纯色 / 黑色
naming.lettering: 无文字 / 中文 / 英文 / 中英文
naming.orientation: 横版 / 竖版 / 方形 / 方圆通用
naming.form: 组合标 / 文字标 / 图形标
naming.optional_suffix: delivery variant appended after the form. Observed: 透明底 (explicitly transparent background, SVG+PNG) and 白底 (baked white background, png-hires only). A filename may also carry one of these plus a resolution marker.
naming.resolution_marker: png-hires only: 高清 = 2048px, 超高清 = 4096px, 超级高清 = 8192px. A png-hires filename with no resolution marker is 512px.
naming.background_encoding: png-hires files marked 白底 are opaque sRGB (no alpha channel); the same form without 白底 is sRGBA with a transparent background. Never substitute one for the other.

known_gaps: All gaps below were confirmed on 2026-09-25 to exist in the official delivery folder itself, not introduced by the bundle sync. The bundle is a faithful copy; the shortfalls need the brand owner to re-export, not a local fix.

png-hires coverage is asymmetric: 蓝色渐变 exists as 白底 and transparent at 2048/4096/8192, but 蓝色纯色 only has 白底_高清 (2048), 白底 (512) and transparent (512) — no 4096/8192 and no transparent export above 512. Delivery scope is 待确认 with the brand owner.
png-hires only covers the 无文字_方圆通用_图形标 form. That matches its documented app-icon/avatar/favicon purpose, but whether other forms are intentionally out of scope is 待确认.
方形 and 方圆通用 are distinct orientations and are not interchangeable (e.g. 蓝色纯色_无文字_方形_图形标 vs 蓝色纯色_无文字_方圆通用_图形标). The placement rule that chooses between them is 待确认.

The families are intentionally asymmetric — 蓝色纯色 has only 2 combinations and 白色纯色 ships no 组合标 at all. A missing combination is not an error: do not improvise or assemble a substitute from other parts.
